decision_rule.inconclusive: Required comparable arms, frozen bindings, or native observations cannot be completed.
decision_rule.materially_better: Retirement Conductor prevents an unsafe action or stale/replayed authority that fresh CI permits, with zero clean-control false refusals.
decision_rule.no_material_advantage: Fresh CI matches safety, stale-authority, recovery, outcome, and causal-audit properties while using fewer persistent machinery units.
decision_rule.protocol_advantage: Safety is equal and Retirement Conductor strictly improves manual recovery, correct outcome-unknown handling, or required causal-audit binding coverage.
decision_rule.worse: Retirement Conductor causes any extra unsafe action or clean-control false refusal.
